title: Tiny, cute armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x="25" y="30" width="50" height="35" rx="10" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- backrest highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="35" width="40" height="10" rx="5" fill="#ff9ec0"/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x="20" y="58" width="60" height="18" rx="8" fill="#ff8fb5"/>
  <!-- seat cushion top edge -->
  <rect x="20" y="58" width="60" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ffb3ce"/>
  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x="12" y="45" width="16" height="30" rx="8" fill="#e8558a"/>
  <!-- left armrest top -->
  <rect x="12" y="45" width="16" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ff9ec0"/>
  <!-- right armrest -->
  <rect x="72" y="45" width="16" height="30" rx="8" fill="#e8558a"/>
  <!-- right armrest top -->
  <rect x="72" y="45" width="16" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ff9ec0"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x="26" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#c93d70"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x="66" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#c93d70"/>
  <!-- cute button tuft -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="4" fill="#ffd1e0"/>
  <!-- cushion detail lines -->
  <rect x="35" y="63" width="30" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffd1e0" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
